استوءرت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْءَرْتُ (istawʔartu) /is.taw.ʔar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# اِسْتَوْءَرْتَ (istawʔarta) /is.taw.ʔar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْأَرَ (istawʔara) and اِسْتَوْءَرَ (istawʔara)
# اِسْتَوْءَرْتِ (istawʔarti) /is.taw.ʔar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
